name: Spinning Rings
description: Odd and even cells split top and bottom borders into a checkerboard of half-rings, spinning to full rings on hover.

code.style: --rule: ( border-radius: 50%; @odd { border-top: 2px solid var(--color1); } @even { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color1); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; grid-gap: -1px; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
